description: This header provides helper functions and enums for testing the 'Cord' class in the Abseil library, including creating multi-segment Cords and testing with various sizes.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Converts TestCordSize enum to a string view.

methods.name: Length
methods.description: Returns the size corresponding to a TestCordSize enum value.

methods.name: operator<<
methods.description: Outputs a TestCordSize enum as a string to an ostream.

methods.name: MakeFragmentedCord
methods.description: Creates a multi-segment Cord from a container of strings for testing purposes.
